capabilities.name: Versioned task state events
capabilities.description: Appends bounded task-scoped events with monotonic per-task revisions and deterministic snapshots within one process.

capabilities.name: Event ID idempotency
capabilities.description: Returns the existing snapshot for an identical event ID and rejects conflicting reuse within process lifetime.

capabilities.name: Opaque context references
capabilities.description: Stores bounded opaque context references without dereferencing or executing content.
